title: 3 Paris - 3 Lucerne - 1 Zurich

services.description: Paris airport to Paris hotel private transfer
Paris City Tour, Seine Cruise and Eiffel Tower 2nd Floor, 4 hrs coach tour

day_descriptions.Day 1: Arrive in Paris, the most romantic city in the world. A private transfer takes you to your hotel, followed by a free evening to stroll along the Seine.
day_descriptions.Day 2: Take a comprehensive city tour including the Eiffel Tower and a relaxing Seine cruise. See the Louvre and the Arc de Triomphe from the comfort of a luxury coach.
day_descriptions.Day 3: A day at leisure in Paris. Explore Montmartre's artist district or indulge in some high-end shopping at the Galeries Lafayette.
day_descriptions.Day 4: Bid adieu to Paris and board a high-speed train to Lucerne, Switzerland. Nestled on the shores of Lake Lucerne, this city is a mountain-lover's paradise.
day_descriptions.Day 5: Ascend the world's first revolving cable car to the summit of Mount Titlis. Enjoy snow and ice activities all year round before returning to Lucerne.
day_descriptions.Day 6: Spend a free day exploring Lucerne. Walk across the Chapel Bridge or take a leisurely boat trip on the crystal-clear waters of the lake.
day_descriptions.Day 7: Take a short train ride to Zurich, Switzerland's largest city and financial hub. Discover its charming Old Town (Altstadt) and vibrant lakeside promenades.
day_descriptions.Day 8: Enjoy a final morning in Zurich before your departure. Don't forget to pick up some world-famous Swiss chocolates!

vehicle_cost.description: Private coach on disposal basis from Day 3 till Day 8
